name: neon-clicker-dev
description: Dev-only manifest for the five regression harnesses (.smoke-test / .vk-mock-check / .visual-check / .stress-check / .release-check). NOT part of the VK Mini App release. The release is assembled by tools/build-release.cjs into _site/ from exactly six files: index.html, style.css, game.js, vk-integration.js, the vendored vk-bridge (tools/vendor.json) and privacy.html — the public privacy policy rendered from assets/moderation/privacy-policy.md. Nothing here is loaded by the app.

scripts.test: npm run build:release && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:vk && npm run test:visual && npm run test:stress
